rules.t3: Category is one of seven open categories.
rules.t4: Identical seven domains, plus a required non-empty subcategory.

rules.t3: Task is not a milestone task.
rules.t4: No milestone concept found in T4 sources.
rules.note: Likely T3-programme specific. Not carried over.

rules.t3: Task must not require a GPU.
rules.t4: Up to one GPU permitted; gpu_types validated against canonical Modal strings.

rules.t3: Canary strings forbidden in every component.
rules.t4: Canary string REQUIRED in instruction.md, task.toml, environment/Dockerfile and every text file under solution/ and tests/.
rules.note: Direct inversion. T3 excludes canaries because it is a training dataset; T4 requires them because it is a public benchmark.

rules.t3: environment_mode = "separate".
rules.t4: Five mechanical conditions: environment_mode, top-level artifacts, tests/Dockerfile, COPY into /tests, RUN mkdir -p for artifact parents.

rules.t3: artifacts declared at the top level of task.toml.
rules.t4: Same requirement, now one of five conditions in check-separate-verifier.

rules.t3: difficulty, solution_explanation, verification_explanation, relevant_experience required as [metadata] fields.
rules.t4: author_name, author_email, category, subcategory, tags, expert_time_estimate_hours required in task.toml; the four explanations are required README '##' sections. 'difficulty' is not a valid T4 field.
rules.note: 66 of 70 merged tasks use README sections.

rules.t3: agent.timeout_sec between 1800 and 18000.
rules.t4: Capped at 28800; no floor. All 66 merged tasks use the flat 8h value.
rules.note: T3 floor would fail every merged T4 task.

rules.t3: network_mode set to public or no-network intentionally.
rules.t4: Open internet assumed; allow_internet must be omitted entirely, not set either way.

rules.t3: Submission targets the Terminus-3-Prod project.
rules.t4: [task] name = "terminal-bench/<folder>".

rules.t3: Starter-template placeholders such as REPLACE removed.
rules.t4: Template defaults (empty category, tags, expert_time_estimate_hours = 0) are rejected as unfilled.

rules.t3: Required task files and directories present.
rules.t4: Same scaffold plus a required README with four named sections.

rules.t3: tests/Dockerfile included.
rules.t4: Same, as a separate-verifier condition.

rules.t3: tests/test.sh follows canonical entrypoint behaviour.
rules.t4: uv isolation mechanically; binary 0/1 reward and CTRF reporting in the rubric.

rules.t3: Instructions state goal, constraints and deliverable.
rules.t4: Human-written, concise, absolute paths, no fluff; plus check-task-absolute-path and check-instruction-suffix mechanically.

rules.t3: Domain-grounded and targets a difficult coding-agent workflow.
rules.t4: Split into difficult (needs professional expertise) and interesting (real-world value). The bar is explicitly higher.

rules.t3: Not a trivial formatting or boilerplate edit.
rules.t4: Difficulty must stem from logical reasoning, not formatting minutiae.

rules.t3: Evidence for the expected difficulty tier; metadata.difficulty field.
rules.t4: No self-declared tier. A README Difficulty explanation section plus expert_time_estimate_hours; difficulty judged by reviewers and /run pass rates.
rules.note: metadata.difficulty is not a valid T4 field.

rules.t3: Category, subcategory and tags align with the taxonomy.
rules.t4: subcategory is mandatory and validated; taxonomy published in TAXONOMY.md.

rules.t3: An oracle or reference solution is included.
rules.t4: A working solution that passes all tests, validated by the oracle run.

rules.t3: Oracle represents a correct solution.
rules.t4: Solution demonstrates actual computation, not hardcoded answers.

rules.t3: Verifier checks semantics rather than appearance.
rules.t4: Tests verify actual behaviour through execution, not source-code keywords.

rules.t3: Verifier rejects a deliberately wrong solution.
rules.t4: Covered by /cheat adversarial trials and the nop validation run, both of which execute code. No static equivalent.
rules.note: Not statically decidable. Stays advisory in both profiles.

rules.t3: Ground truth not read from agent-writable paths.
rules.t4: Tests resist adversarial agent behaviour; also probed by /cheat trials.

rules.t3: Verifier does not rely only on proxy checks.
rules.t4: Same intent, folded into functional_verification.

rules.t3: Verifier does not grade a stale binary.
rules.t4: Folded into anti_cheat_robustness.

rules.t3: Verifier covers tolerances and tie-breaks when relevant.
rules.t4: Any inequality-based check must have its bounds justified in the README verification explanation.

rules.t3: Tests deterministic, no flaky timing or external state.
rules.t4: Consistent across runs with pinned dependencies and no live-service dependency.

rules.t3: Local validation or CI feedback documented.
rules.t4: Superseded by automated Docker build, oracle and nop validation on every push, which execute code and are outside this checker's scope.

rules.t3: Docker/environment setup included.
rules.t4: environment/Dockerfile required; tests/Dockerfile additionally required.

rules.t3: Dockerfile follows documented requirements.
rules.t4: Mechanical apt rules in check-dockerfile-sanity; image cleanliness in environment_hygiene (agent image must not carry tests/solution or test-only deps).

rules.t3: Dockerfile FROM images must be digest-pinned.
rules.t4: No such rule. Package pinning is enforced instead.
rules.note: Only 8 of 69 merged tasks digest-pin; no check script enforces it.

rules.t3: Python package installs pin exact versions.
rules.t4: check-pip-pinning requires == everywhere; check-pytest-version additionally pins pytest and pytest-json-ctrf to repo-wide canonical versions.

rules.t3: No FROM --platform.
rules.t4: Same.

rules.t3: No bare nproc.
rules.t4: Same; nproc --all permitted.

rules.t3: Task does not require privileged Docker or unsafe container flags.
rules.t4: No explicit T4 rule names privileged container flags. task_security covers exploitation of the agent or host in general terms only.
rules.note: Kept as a non-blocking advisory scan in the T4 profile. The T4 criterion verifier_execution_isolation concerns running agent code unprivileged inside the verifier, which is a different control.

rules.t3: Runtime and test dependencies declared in the ZIP.
rules.t4: Declaration plus exact == pinning, and verifier tooling baked into the image rather than installed at trial time.

rules.t3: No hidden instructions or AI-framework scaffolding in environment files.
rules.t4: The answer must not be reachable by trivial inspection.

rules.t3: No hidden local files, private services or undeclared external resources.
rules.t4: Trial-time fetches mechanically blocked; live-service dependence judged in the rubric.

rules.t3: ZIP excludes caches, build artefacts and secrets.
rules.t4: Task directory contains only files needed to build, run, solve or verify.

rules.t3: Materials do not instruct contributors to contact reviewers directly.
rules.t4: No counterpart found. T4 actively directs authors to Discord and maintainers.

rules.t3: Task is ready for reviewer checklist inspection.
rules.t4: Non-specialist reviewers can verify correctness, or sufficient explanation is given.

rules.t3: Rubric or evaluation notes present for nuanced judgement.
rules.t4: README Verification explanation describes how tests establish correctness.

rules.t3: Known FAQ/troubleshooting issues addressed.
rules.t4: No counterpart found.
rules.note: Recommended severity in T3; not carried over.

rules.t3: Kernel tasks CPU-simulated or compile-only.
rules.t4: GPUs permitted (max 1, H100), so the constraint no longer follows.

rules.t3: Multi-container tasks tagged under metadata.
rules.t4: No tagging requirement found; compose is constrained to named volumes instead.

rules.t3: Performance thresholds not too tight relative to the oracle.
rules.t4: Numeric bounds must be justified and calibrated in the verification explanation.

rules.t3: Failed runs write 0 to the reward file.
rules.t4: Exactly 0 or 1 on every reachable path; no partial credit.

rules.t3: Environment variables in test.sh have compatible defaults.
rules.t4: No verified T4 counterpart found.
rules.note: Retained as advisory only. Absence of a check script is not proof of removal.

Stated do-not-modify constraints are actually enforced
